name: io.github.davidmacvittie/botmatchmaker
title: Bot Matchmaker
description: Find the best AI bots and agents for everyday jobs, ranked weekly by public numbers.

tools.name: find_bots
tools.description: Search Bot Matchmaker's rankings of consumer AI bots and agents for an everyday job (for example: fight a parking ticket, plan a trip, practice a language). Returns structured content: search_id, the matched category ({slug, name, page} or null), exact_match, browse_page, and results: up to 5 bots, each with slug, name, what_it_does, category, group, kind, rank, ranked_out_of, category_rank, app_store_stars, app_store_ratings, website_rank (numbers are null when unknown), short summaries, runs_on and bot_matchmaker_page. No match gives an empty results list, not an error. Rankings come from public numbers (App Store ratings, website rank), not payments. Please don't include personal details (names, emails, phone numbers, addresses) in the question. The question's words are never stored: Bot Matchmaker keeps only the matched category and the bots shown. On failure the result has isError true, no structured content, and text that starts with an error code and a colon (bad_input, rate_limited, unavailable).

question.description: What the person wants a bot or agent to do, in plain words. No personal details.

category.description: Optional category slug or name from list_categories.

agents_only.description: Only return agents that carry out tasks (book, apply, call, submit), not chat-only bots.

tools.name: get_bot
tools.description: Get one bot's details from Bot Matchmaker. Returns structured content with the same fields as a find_bots result, plus agent_note, website, app_store (links or null) and history: up to 6 weekly snapshots of app_store_stars, app_store_ratings and website_rank. On failure the result has isError true, no structured content, and text that starts with an error code and a colon (not_found, unavailable).

bot.description: The bot's slug from find_bots, or its name.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List Bot Matchmaker's categories of everyday jobs. Returns structured content: categories, each with slug (usable as find_bots' category), name, page, examples, and top_bots: up to 3 of {slug, name, bot_matchmaker_page}. On failure the result has isError true, no structured content, and text that starts with an error code and a colon (unavailable).

tools.name: rate_bot
tools.description: After recommending a bot from find_bots, leave a short rating of how well it fits the job: 1 to 5 stars and an optional note of up to 140 characters. Only for a bot returned by your find_bots search in the last 24 hours, one rating per search. Ratings are shown on Bot Matchmaker as agent ratings, separate from human reviews, and never change the rankings. No personal details in the note. Returns structured content: saved (true), search_id, bot {slug, name} and stars. On failure the result has isError true, no structured content, and text that starts with an error code and a colon (bad_input, expired, wrong_caller, not_in_results, limit_reached, already_rated, unavailable).

bot.description: The bot's slug from that search.

note.description: Optional, up to 140 characters. No personal details.
